d:
Scores of elderly men and women flocked to the Ramlila Maidan Sunday in support of the INDIA alliance’s anti-SIR protest. While many said they had been left out of the rolls in the SIR, others said they turned up to “protect the younger generations’ right to vote”.
Watch Alisha Dutta’s ground report from Ramlila Maidan, Delhi.
